body:
**Amendment 2026-07-29 (operator request):** body edited in place to add a **label channel** — the original scope only sourced the `.devagent-step-models` marker from `## Workflow flags` body keys and the body `tier:` shim, which leaves label-only conventions inert.

What surfaced it: factorAI#85 (`tier:check-fable` label) ran every checking-class step at opus — the config floor — because factorAI steers exclusively by labels (`tier:impl-<model>` / `tier:check-<model>`, both classes, no flags block anywhere in the project) and nothing consumes labels at scaffold time. factorAI#87/#90/#92/#93 carry the same latent miss, as do label-only koopman-gnn issues (`tier:<model>-checking`).

Verified before amending: `pull.sh` has zero label logic; both backends already fetch labels and render them into issue.md's `- Labels:` line (`scripts/issue/github.sh:57`, `scripts/lib/backend-common.sh:28`), so the payload exists at scaffold time and is simply dropped.

Changes to the body: label channel in Proposed behavior (three recognized shapes, both classes; per-class precedence body key > body shim > label > config; fail-closed on same-class label conflicts and illegal model tokens; warn-and-ignore on unrecognized `tier:*` labels), matching pull.sh/API bullets, five new ACs (including the factorAI#85 miss shape), byte-identical AC extended to "no keys and no recognized labels", Out of scope extended (no label-spelling normalization, no post-scaffold label re-sync), title updated.

**Correction + scope check 2026-07-29 (same day, second edit):**

1. **Stale step numbers fixed.** The capture predated #560's renumber and cited the old scheme (thinking 1/7/8/9/12, checking 3/13/14/21). Corrected everywhere — body prose and three ACs — to the canonical execution-order map at HEAD (`config.sh` class map): thinking **2 draft / 9 implement / 10 quality / 11 document / 14 draftmr**, checking **5 improve / 15 review / 16 redmr / 17 preship**.

2. **Enforcement split now stated.** Verified the delegation chain: the dispatched steps consume the resolved tier as the Agent-tool `model:` override (draft's planner via `step-model.sh <project> 2`; improve/review/redmr/preship per `docs/checking-dispatch-contract.md`, with rc 0 = tier, rc 3 = wrapper-carried agent default, rc 2 = inherit). The inline thinking steps (implement/quality/document/draftmr) only surface the tier as the `next`/`catchup` advisory hint — so `checking-model` is fully enforced, `implementation-model` enforced for draft and advisory for the rest. The body now says so, and requires docs to carry the split beside the class mapping.

3. **Scope check — no further keys warranted** (operator question: do other steps deserve the convention?). Script-backed steps (pull, branch, commit, analyze, ship, mergetoall, updatewbs, cleanup) are exec'd shell — no model runs them, nothing to steer. Inline skills (scope, prune, tighten, impact, lessonslearned) can only be hinted. research (1) and spike (3) run inline by recorded decision (research.md documents the dispatch variant as considered-and-deferred) — a key for them would be grammar with no consumer; revisit if they ever become dispatched. Config's per-step `step_models.<N>` rung remains the escape hatch. Recorded in Source.
